specifications.reference_configuration: Selected 2016 catalogue double reference: 39T total capacity; the separately printed triple reference is 41T. Existing handbook limits of 34T largest, 11T smallest and 16T front difference remain the double reference.
specifications.capacity_reference_note: The 2016 catalogue explicitly distinguishes 39T for 2× and 41T for 3×. The later handbook lists a generic 41T maximum without that split; it is not applied indiscriminately to this selected double reference.
